EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.desc:
How long every emote stays on screen.
Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.title: Reverse Scroll Page Direction
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.hover.de: While the emote wheel is open, scrolling down goes to the next page and scrolling up to the previous one. Turn this on to swap them.
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY.title: Emotes on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY_HINT.title:
Click an emote to hide or show it on your wheel (the wheel closes the gaps). If every emote is hidden, all are shown.
Doesn't affect the emotes other players use.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.title: Show All
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.title: Hide All
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Map Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.d: How long emotes made while the map is open stay on screen. They point at a place, so they stay longer by default. Only affects what you see.
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.title: Emotes in Singleplayer
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.hover.d: Use the emote wheel in singleplayer runs too.
